author: Tâigí Taiwanese Diplomat, Ku--ê the Formosan
text:
Great to learn the vision of Trustroot and now I do have a general view across the similar platforms, and I do want to make a change about the current situation so I posted the idea like this in the forum of Coucher.org and BeWelcome, anyway, I wish the best for all of us.

I'm tired of the mainstream social media so why can't we replace them with the meaningful platform we're using and can Coucher, BeWelcome, Trustroot merge?
